d: Qatar Aircraft Catering Company (QACC) is one of the world's largest flight catering facilities, delivering exceptional culinary experiences for Qatar Airways and its customers. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, QACC is committed to delivering the highest standards of quality, innovation, food safety, and operational excellence.

As an Equipment Processing Duty Officer, you will be responsible for setting standard operating procedures, implementing and monitoring the department's productivity and quality goals. You will analyze the technical needs of cleaning and washing, train subordinates, and manage the entire process of receiving, washing, packing, and timely delivery of equipment in accordance with airline specifications and standard operating procedures. You will assess operational requirements, manage departmental resources effectively, act as the master operator of all systems installed within Equipment Processing, and serve as a safety champion to always ensure a safe workplace and environment.

Assesses the resources required for specific tasks and ensures their optimization.

Disciplining employees without causing resentment and copes effectively with conflicts, by applying all rules and regulations fairly in conflict resolution and handling sensitive situation with confidence.
Initiate formal measures to correct misconduct and make recommendations for disciplinary actions constructively and timely.

Fully accountable for quality assurance and engages into critical level of capacity planning and scheduling. Applies sound analytical thinking, strives to develop innovative and creative solutions. Is realistically enthusiastic.
Conducts regular meetings with Maintenance and Cleaning team to discuss improvement plans to fix operational challenges.
Responsible for updating all changes of galley loading plans and packing specifications in internal systems and applications.
Responsible for forecasting, planning and requesting airline equipment as and when required.

Oversee the records, prepare reports and compose correspondence relative to the work.

Perform other department duties related to his/her position as directed by the Head of the Department.
